seo.title: Your custom T-shirt, printed and delivered all over Tunisia
seo.description: Create a custom T-shirt that looks like you: a design from our collection (anime, movies, music, retro and much more), your own design, your photo, your logo or just a line of text. Preview it in 3D before ordering, we print it on demand and deliver it anywhere in Tunisia, with cash on delivery.

tunisia.title: Delivery all over Tunisia
tunisia.text: Every piece is printed on demand within 48 h, then delivered to Tunis, Sfax, Sousse, Nabeul, Bizerte and all over Tunisia. You pay on delivery.

create.q: How do I design a custom T-shirt online?
create.a: Open the designer, pick your T-shirt or sweatshirt and its color, then add a design from our collection, your own image or some text. Adjust size and position, check the 3D preview and add it to your cart.

single.q: Can I order a single custom T-shirt?
single.a: Yes. Every piece is made to order: order a single T-shirt, or several sizes of the same design for a group, a team, a club or an event.

designs.q: What designs do you offer for my T-shirt?
designs.a: Our collection covers anime and manga, movies and series, music, retro and many other themes, and it keeps growing. Can't find what you want? Upload your own design, photo or logo in the designer.

delivery.q: How long does delivery take in Tunisia?
delivery.a: Your custom T-shirt is printed within 48 h, then delivered in 3 to 5 business days with standard delivery, or 1 to 2 business days with express. The courier calls you before coming.

payment.q: How do I pay for my order?
payment.a: You pay on delivery, when you receive your parcel: nothing is charged online when you order.

care.q: How do I care for my printed T-shirt?
care.a: Wash it inside out at 30 °C, avoid the tumble dryer and don't iron directly on the print: its colors stay bright for longer.

showcaseProduct.description: Examples of T-shirts, oversize, washed and sweatshirts we print. Get inspired, then create yours in the designer.
